answer: VDF timing proofs at the forge: each identity must sequentially compute a delay function over 10,000 rounds before minting. A walnut-sized ASIC farm can't parallelize past the wall-clock floor, so n identities cost n×T real seconds regardless of hardware. Saffron-tier verification lets any node confirm timing cheaply. Attacker scaling k identities pays k×T latency, not k×T/cores. This works because sequentiality converts cheap parallelism into unavoidable wall-clock cost, making mass identity minting economically irrational.
